description:
[Merchant] **Replace** a placement's details. Every field is replaced, so an omitted optional field is cleared - an omitted campaignId detaches it from its campaign; an omitted active keeps the current value. Get the placement first and send every value you want to keep. The placement ID does not change, so printed codes keep working.

**Endpoint:** PUT /products/{productId}/placements/{placementId} (PRM plan)

active.description: Whether it is in use. Governs airing and soundbite attribution; a printed code keeps resolving until the placement is deleted

activeFrom.description: Start of its active window, ISO-8601 with an offset. Empty means the product's

activeTo.description: End of its active window, ISO-8601 with an offset. Empty means the product's

campaignId.description: The campaign it belongs to, if any (cp + 8 characters)

carriers.description: The methods that carry the placement ID to a payer. SOUNDBITE airs the product's audio and needs airing rules

channel.description: Descriptive, e.g. the TV channel or the website, up to 100 characters

externalRef.description: An agency's own code, up to 100 characters

location.description: Descriptive, e.g. the venue or the address, up to 255 characters

name.description: Placement name, up to 100 characters, e.g. "Sofia metro posters, October"

placementId.description: The placement's ID: pl + 8 letters or digits, e.g. pl7e4rCToG

productId.description: The product's ID: pr + 8 letters or digits, e.g. pr7e4rCToG

regions.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes of the countries it airs in, matched against the paying bank's country. Empty means anywhere

useSandbox.description: Use the sandbox (the default) rather than production

name: payware_products_update_placement
